use_when: the required capability is known but the appropriate provider/resource is not
the host can query an ARD-compatible catalog such as GitHub Agent Finder or an enterprise catalog
avoid_when: a trusted provider is already known and available
the task only needs local project capability

notes: Prefer an ARD implementation already available in the current host or organization.
ARD discovery returns candidates; do not silently connect/install them.
The ARD specification is evolving, so re-check current schemas before building a client adapter.

credentials: catalog-specific only when querying a private registry
permissions: discovery/read access to the selected catalog

checks: query the catalog with one concrete capability description
confirm ranked results identify compatible resource types and sources
apply AAOP provider-selection policy before any installation

steps: remove the catalog endpoint/credential from host configuration if it was added solely for this project

warnings: ARD is a discovery layer, not an execution runtime or trust decision.
